title: The Jungle's Hidden Legacy

scenes.text: Elara enters a dense jungle searching for a legendary artifact.
scenes.image_prompt: female explorer walking through dense jungle with map

scenes.summary: She meets Finn and faces traps.
scenes.text: Elara teams up with Finn and they overcome dangerous traps guarding the temple.
scenes.image_prompt: explorers solving ancient trap near jungle temple entrance

scenes.text: They enter a hidden temple filled with puzzles and mysterious carvings.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient temple interior with glowing artifact pedestal

scenes.text: They must prove their courage and intelligence to claim the artifact.
scenes.image_prompt: explorers solving magical puzzle challenge inside temple

scenes.text: By working together, they overcome all trials and uncover the artifact.
scenes.image_prompt: two explorers celebrating discovery of glowing artifact

story: Elara and Finn explore a jungle temple in search of a valuable artifact. Facing traps and trials, they rely on teamwork and intelligence to succeed. Their journey highlights the importance of collaboration.
